div.head: Abt 80
div.ab: Gif ceorl agan wile: swa an bearn.
Gif ceorl agan wile, swa an bearn.
Gif ceorl agan wile, swa an bearn.
Wenn der Ehemann [die Kinder] behalten will, [werde sie bedacht] wie Ein Kind[estheil].
If the husband wishes to keep [the children], [let her be provided for] as one child[’s share].
If the husband wishes to keep [the children], she shall have a share of the goods equal to a child’s.
If the husband wishes to keep [the children], [she is to have the same share] as a child.
If she should wish to take a man [i.e., another husband], provision as for one child [i.e., the inheritance is split equally between the mother and each of the children].

note.seg: Die Ergänzung lieferte Hickes; Wilkins verderbte sie wie gewöhnlich; falsch in anderer Weise Phillipps Vers. Agsä. Rechts 145. Vgl. Gl eheliches Güterrecht 1 B II
The restoration was supplied by Hickes; Wilkins corrupted it, as usual; Phillipps Vers. Agsä. Rechts 145 is wrong in a different way. Cf. Gl eheliches Güterrecht 1 B II
